experiment_data.hypothesis: DetectGPT (Mitchell et al. 2023) perturbation discrepancy scores, when calibrated to 4-class ordinal depth via equal-width/CORAL/threshold methods, achieve near-chance accuracy (30-35%) on 9-cell atlas. Establishes that perturbation-based binary detection lacks ordinal resolution. Rebuttal ammunition against "binary detectors might also detect depth."
